name: Build Android APK

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch: {}

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Add Android platform (first run only)
        run: |
          if [ ! -d "android" ]; then
            npx cap add android
          fi

      - name: Generate app icons + splash screen from resources/
        run: npx @capacitor/assets generate --android

      - name: Sync web assets into Android project
        run: npx cap sync android

      - name: Place google-services.json
        run: |
          if [ -f "google-services.json" ]; then
            cp google-services.json android/app/google-services.json
          else
            echo "WARNING: google-services.json not found at repo root — push notifications will not work until you add it."
          fi

      - name: Grant execute permission to gradlew
        run: chmod +x android/gradlew

      - name: Build debug APK
        working-directory: android
        run: ./gradlew assembleDebug

      - name: Upload debug APK artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: make-love-hub-debug-apk
          path: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk

      # ─── Signed release build — only runs once you've added the keystore secrets below ───
      - name: Check for release signing secrets
        id: relcheck
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ secrets.RELEASE_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}" ]; then
            echo "has_keystore=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "has_keystore=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Decode release keystore
        if: steps.relcheck.outputs.has_keystore == 'true'
        run: echo "${{ secrets.RELEASE_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}" | base64 -d > android/app/release.keystore

      - name: Add release signing config to build.gradle
        if: steps.relcheck.outputs.has_keystore == 'true'
        run: |
          python3 - << 'PYEOF'
          import re
          p = "android/app/build.gradle"
          src = open(p).read()

          signing_block = '''
              signingConfigs {
                  release {
                      storeFile file('release.keystore')
                      storePassword System.getenv("RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD")
                      keyAlias System.getenv("RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS")
                      keyPassword System.getenv("RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD")
                  }
              }
          '''

          # IMPORTANT: point buildTypes.release at the signing config BEFORE
          # inserting the signingConfigs block itself — otherwise this regex
          # would match the first "release {" it finds, which after insertion
          # would be signingConfigs.release instead of buildTypes.release.
          if "signingConfig signingConfigs.release" not in src:
              src = re.sub(
                  r"(release\s*\{)",
                  r"\1\n            signingConfig signingConfigs.release",
                  src,
                  count=1
              )

          # now insert signingConfigs block right before buildTypes {
          if "signingConfigs {" not in src:
              src = src.replace("buildTypes {", signing_block + "\n    buildTypes {", 1)

          open(p, "w").write(src)
          print("build.gradle patched")
          PYEOF

      - name: Build signed release APK
        if: steps.relcheck.outputs.has_keystore == 'true'
        working-directory: android
        env:
          RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD }}
          RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS }}
          RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: ./gradlew assembleRelease

      - name: Upload signed release APK
        if: steps.relcheck.outputs.has_keystore == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: make-love-hub-release-apk
          path: android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
